entries.text: Arkie there wasn't in a fight. Car crash, head-on collision into a tree. Drunk as a skunk.

entries.text: He's lucky to be alive.

entries.text: You have no Idea.

entries.text: Not wearing a seat belt, I suspect.

entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: To hear Arkie tell it, he didn't have time to fasten his seat belt... ... Because he was busy running from the boy he says caused the accident. And who was that? You're looking at him.

entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: No. Not me. What, he blames himself?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: In a manner of speaking.

entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: I don't get it, Mulder.

entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Arkie, our hapless road warrior...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: ...IS driving by his lonesome down the highway to hell...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: ...When he sees another Arkie, across from him, who grabs the wheel and crashes the vehicle. Well, you did say he was drunk.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: I know what you're gonna say about seeing double...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: ...And the bromides about not giving the kids the car keys.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Twenty is hardly a kid.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Circumstances bear a curious similarity to stories told by other good folk... ...Who didn't share Arkie Seavers' luck.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Who also reported seeing their doubles before dying.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: And how did these people die?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Each by their own hand.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: After seeing their doubles?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: According to all reports out of Henrico County, Virginia.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Reports issued by whom?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Friends, relatives. A doctor. And the medical diagnosis Is...?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: A rare form of schizophrenia. Heh. Right, so rare I've never heard of it.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Correct me if I'm wrong, Scully, and I know you will...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: ...Out schizophrenics hear voices and report hallucinations similar to Arkie’s.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Hallucinations, yes...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: ...Not grabbing the wheel of a car and ramming it into a tree. Well, they didn't all die from car crashes into trees. Seven died from hanging, four jumped off a tall bridge, three--
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: This is a mass phenomenon.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: Precisely my thinking, Scully...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: ...Which is why you and I are gonna jump on I-95 south...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: ...And get back to our bread and butter.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. X-Files Office - Day

entries.text: These the FBI agents? Agents Scully and Mulder.
entries.speaker: Dean Cavalier

entries.text: And you filled them in? Mm-hm.
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: We know the facts, Arkie. We'd like to hear the details.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: Okay, I-- I looked over, and he grabbed the wheel...
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: ...And he floored the gas. And by "he," you mean...?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: I mean, the dude looked just like me. And you'd seen him before.
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: Yes. Like, four times. He'd been following me for like a week. Had he ever said anything?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: No, I'd see him in a crowd or a window.
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: I thought I was tripping or something.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: And do you take drugs, Arkie? No, I'm-- Eh.
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: Yeah, maybe once or twice, I mean....
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: And you're tn jail because...? Arkie admittedly has a problem.
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: A few previous DUI offenses.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: Exactly how many is a few? I don't know, like...
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: SIX. So the judge is gonna throw the book at you. But that's not what we're interested In. We want to know how you came to be the lone survivor.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: Why I'm not dead like all the other people, right?
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: What do you chalk that up to? I can tell you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: And it's the same reason I can prove I'm not lying.
entries.speaker: Arkie
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: You can prove it?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. County Jail - Conference Room - Henrico County - Day Ata

entries.text: You gotta admit, Scully, the kid's story makes a lot of sense.

entries.text: Arkie's double takes control of the wheel.

entries.text: Then Arkie pumps the brakes with his left foot... ...Roducing the skid marks that start up yonder.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: Or there's another explanation, of course... ...Which is that Arkie, in his perpetual state of inebriation... .. Falls asleep at the wheel, waking up to find he's going off the highway... ..And applying the brakes there. But if he was asleep...

entries.text: ...Ne wouldn't have been traveling at such a dangerous rate of speed.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: You're saying you believe him. No.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: I'm just saying that I think the kid's too stupid to make it up.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: Yes, I treated several of the victims manifesting the symptoms.

entries.text: Their episodes suggest a pattern of shared hallucination.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: None of them had psychiatric problems before?

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: Dr. Russell, your diagnosis is of a nonconforming type of schizophrenia.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: That was my clinical opinion.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: So they were mentally ill?

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: They became mentally ill. It was almost like a kind of outbreak.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: So would you say like a mass hysteria?

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: I've never heard of a suicidal mass hysteria.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: A phenomenon known as suicide clusters or suicide contagion...

entries.text: ... Have been known to affect whole communities or social groups.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: Nothing matching that particular pattern. Why?

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: Mm. More a normative schizophrenic.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: Could we possibly talk to her? I'd strongly advise against that.

entries.location: Ext. Highway - Day

entries.text: Why would you say that? Because she exhibits split personality... ...With wild swings tn affect, from benign to violent. Unless you've got some good reason, I'd steer clear.

entries.text: Mulder, go back to sleep.

entries.text: Somebody want to explain this to me? Who found him there? One of the trustees. That guy. This happens all the time, don't know what to tell you.

entries.text: He was strangled to death.

entries.text: It looks impossible, and it's highly improbable...

entries.text: ...Out there is ample case history that it can be done.

entries.text: The victim simply spins the belt around and unbuckles it, fastens it to the bars... ... Loops it around his neck, and uses his body as leverage.

entries.text: No, Arkie didn't want to die. I agree with you. This is an outrage. Now, who is gonna stop this carnage?

entries.text: We're working on it. Well, someone's gotta pay.

entries.text: I know what you're thinking. Anyone up for a game of hangman? It's just a coincidence. Judy said that she didn't even know Arkie Seavers.

entries.text: Chucky Poundstone? Speaking to whom? Fox Mulder, I'm with the FBI. Oh, yeah.

entries.text: With that tasty little redhead. You tapping that special agent or can Chucky bust a move?

entries.text: You're that trustee. You found the kid hanged in his jail cell.

entries.text: Yeah, I discovered the moron. Kid had “loser” written all over him. Can I ask you a few questions? Why? Am I under suspicion?

entries.location: Ext. Rmashackle House - Morning

entries.text: It's a simple line of inquiry. Yeah, well, it takes a dipwad to know one. I take it you're twins. Ooh. Powers of deduction. And she's the good twin.

entries.location: Int. Rmashackle House - Dining Room - Morning

entries.text: All right, well, you mind if I take a picture of your wall? For my records.

entries.text: We told her you were coming. Then she flung dookie at us.
entries.speaker: Nurse Peggy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: So this is the other Judy.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: We call her Demon Judy.
entries.speaker: Nurse Peggy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: Why is the light off?
entries.speaker: Dana
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: Makes you a harder target. Sometimes a split personality responds...
entries.speaker: Nurse Peggy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: ...To a strong persona who challenges the psychotic child.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: Both parents hanged themselves.
entries.speaker: Nurse Vickie
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: And you'll come in with me?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: Heh. No way. Heh. Not a chance.
entries.speaker: Nurse Vickie Nurse Peggy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Hallway Outside Little Judy’S Room

entries.text: Judy, it's Agent Scully.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: [JUDY SNICKERING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: I want you to behave yourself. I know what you want, bitch. I wanna know about Arkie. Reached the end of his rope.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: [JUDY LAUGHING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: I'm not afraid of you, Judy. Oh, yes, you are.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Everybody's afraid of sweet Little Judy.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Is Little Judy a killer?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Little Judy's an angel.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: And what about your brother? Is he involved?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Could be. Chucky Poundstone is the devil's dimwitted disciple. Did he kill Arkie Seavers? Arkie Seavers killed himself.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: How did you know that, Judy, if you weren't involved yourself?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Are you trying to trick me, Agent Scully?
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: I want the killing to stop.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Oh. Well, don't you have a heart of gold?
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: What's he see in you, your handsome partner?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: One taste of Little Judy and he'd forget you even exist.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Maybe I can make you go away too.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Are you threatening me?
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: [JUDY LAUGHING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Afraid I'll dirty your cheap little ensemble? You're nothing but a hosebag. How old are you, 40s? Past your childbearing years. You're all dried up, not even half a woman.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: You can't hurt me, Judy.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Nothing hurts like the truth.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Day - Continuous

entries.text: Just a minute.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Hey. What'd you find out, Scully?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: That dookie-winging past your head sends a sharp message to your brain. What message is that? Heh.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: To gather the other apes and make war on your dread enemy.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: I believe I'm in touch with that feeling, Scully.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Really? Did you have dookie flung at you too?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Figuratively. By the queerest little man in the queerest little house.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: I don't know, Mulder, this Judy...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: ...She has some malign influence over these victims.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: I'm at a loss to figure out what it is. I agree, there is some evil in the air, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: No, it's not evil, it's mental illness. There's some kind of psychic transference.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: I wouldn't rule out ghosts.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Well, except for the fact that they don't exist?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Of course there are ghosts. Science has proven stimulation of the brain's left anterior insula...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: ...IS linked to the feeling of a sense presence. Repeated stimulations to an area of the left temporal parietal junction... ...IS what promotes the sense of a shadowy figure... ...Collectively known as the Gastaut-Geschwind syndrome.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Talk about flinging dookie.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: [SIGHS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Mulder, do you think of me as old? What? Where is that coming from?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Maybe in dog years. No. What are you talking about?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Well, a woman thinks about these things.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: No, Scully, you're-- You still got it going on and... ...Neh, you still got some scoot in your boot.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: I'm gonna boot you out of here. Knock three times.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: [SIGHS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Mm.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Bloodsucking scumbag. You think you're gonna point the finger at me?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Four letters, little sister.
entries.speaker: Little Chucky
entries.location: Int. Rmashackle House - Dining Room - Night

entries.text: Is there an E? I thought so.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Night

entries.text: Top of the morning, Agent Muldoon. What's on your mind? I wanna know how you do it. Haven't a clue what you mean.
entries.speaker: Little Chucky
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Is the other Chucky here? The one I talked to yesterday?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Search me, Muldoon, I'm not my brother's keeper--
entries.speaker: Little Chucky
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: It's Mulder, and I think this is an act.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: You choose them at the Jail, don't you? Losers like Arkie Seavers... ...Who you hanged, if not literally, then psychically.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Does that FBI health plan of yours cover anger management, Agent Mulder? Who's next, Mr. Poundstone? You're asking the wrong guy.
entries.speaker: Little Chucky
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: I can have you and your alter ego arrested. I can have you committed.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: On what legal pretense?
entries.speaker: Little Chucky
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Intent to commit a crime. Heh. I've seen many a bad jailhouse lawyer...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: ...Spring far less innocent men than I, Agent Mulder. I'd even venture I'd have grounds to have you censured for abuse of power. You're going down, Poundstone. Tell it to the hand, G-man. That's original. I haven't heard that before. Before I punch you In the face...
entries.speaker: Little Chucky
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: ...And snatch Little Red Riding Hood. There's the Chucky I came for. And that's the Chucky who's eventually gonna hang himself.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Judy? Excuse me, hon. Agent Scully's here to see you.
entries.speaker: Nurse Peggy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: What brings you here today, Agent Scully?
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Do you have any recollection of our exchange that we had yesterday? No memory whatsoever?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: You look mad at me. Lam mad, Judy. I am...
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: ...Angry because I need to stop the killings...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: ...And I don't know how. And you blame me, don't you?
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Are you to blame?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: I'm an actress, Agent Scully. I've never even played a killer.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Where is the person that I talked to here yesterday? Where is that Judy? She's right over there.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: No, she's not. Sure she is. Just look.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: No, she isn't, Judy. And I think that you're pretending that she is.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: You mean I'm pretending so I can sit here in this bed all day?
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: I think you have some kind of power to influence people's lives.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: I think you mean their deaths.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Yes. That's exactly what I mean.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: [WHISPERING] People can protect themselves.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: How’? Protect themselves how?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: By taking these pills. I take them every day to protect me from her, and so far... .. They've worked. Did the nurses give you these? Every morning with breakfast.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Would you consider not playing that game with your brother?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Ooh. Well, what would I do in here all day, Agent Scully?
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: I'd go mad.
entries.speaker: Little Chucky
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: [SCOFFS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: I have a question for you. She said that you give these to her at breakfast every morning...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: ...And that they have secret powers. That's really only half true.
entries.speaker: Nurse Vickie
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: That you give them to her at breakfast or they have secret power?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: We bring her bread every morning and she rolls it into those pills.
entries.speaker: Nurse Peggy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: So these are just bread pills.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: They have no medicinal qualities. No. Not that we know of, anyway.
entries.speaker: Nurse Peggy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: Well, but we both take them.
entries.speaker: Nurse Vickie
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: In case they have secret power.
entries.speaker: Nurse Peggy
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: You might wanna take them too.
entries.speaker: Nurse Vickie
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: [MUSIC PLAYING OVER SPEAKER]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: [SIGHS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Ramshackle House - Morning

entries.text: What'll you have, Dean’? I'll take the lunch special. No mayo, salad on the side, lightly dressed.
entries.speaker: Attractive Waitress
entries.location: Int. Diner - Day

entries.text: And if you bat those baby blues at me, I'll give you a little something on the side too.
entries.speaker: Dean Cavalier
entries.location: Int. Diner - Day

entries.text: Promises are like bananas. Only good when they're appealing. I gotta have you over to my place... ...To see my sword collection. You say that to all the girls. Hey, did you see that guy? Did I see what guy?
entries.speaker: Attractive Waitress
entries.location: Int. Diner - Day

entries.text: Cancel the blue plate. Agent Scully, I saw him.
entries.speaker: Attractive Waitress
entries.location: Ext. Diner - Day

entries.text: Hold your horses, Mr. Cavalier. He looked just like me.
entries.speaker: Dean Cavalier
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Calm down and you can tell us both what it is that happened.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: All right. I saw him through a window, the same way Arkie said he saw his double.
entries.speaker: Dean Cavalier
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Was it the first time? No, no, I think I saw him the other day... ...Staring at me from a bus stop. You're making it worse.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: I'm making it worse? This guy is stalking me. Your paranoia is gonna feed on itself.
entries.speaker: Dean Cavalier
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: You know that mass hysteria is just a symptom of fears run wild.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Those people all died. While I agree with Agent Scully's theory... ... There's a danger and take every precaution against It.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: All right. What should I do?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Stay off the interstate?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: [SIGHS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Do you have a family, Mr. Cavalier? No, I don't. I live by myself.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Okay, well, maybe stay home.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Take some time off work, lock your doors and call the police if you have another panic attack.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Yeah. Well, that's easy for you to say. Take my card.
entries.speaker: Dean Cavalier
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: And just know that it can't haunt you if you don't let it.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.speaker: Dean Cavalier
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Like I said before.
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Clearly there's a dark influence set loose in this town, Scully.
entries.speaker: Dean Cavalier
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Well, by "dark influence," again, I presume you mean “evil,” Mulder.
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: But there is no such thing as evil. I mean, evil is a concept. Like the devil. Oh, the devil is a concept?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Certainly, that's not what they taught young Dana Katherine Scully in Sunday school, is it?
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Well, I certainly believed In the literal devil when I was a child.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: You don't believe that we as humans have dark sides that we sublimate or repress?
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Well, anyone with an imagination can entertain acting out violence or antisocial behavior.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: That doesn't mean that there's an evil twin lurking inside of us.
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Speak for yourself, Scully. And tell that to Chuck and Judy.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Chuck and Judy are mentally ill.
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Explain how they're doing it. I cant.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: But if you eliminate the impossible...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: ...Whatever is remaining, even if improbable, must be the truth.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: No sugar, Sherlock.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: But I have to admit... ...I still sleep with my back to the door in case the devil comes in the night.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Can never be too careful.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: [PANTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: [BEEPING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: [PANTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Ext. Small Town Hotel/Motel - Afternoon

entries.text: Is there an S?
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Evening

entries.text: [MUSIC PLAYING OVER TV]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Evening

entries.text: Damn you, Chucky Poundstone.
entries.speaker: Little Judy
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Evening

entries.text: [PANTING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Evening

entries.text: [GASPS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Mental Hospital - Little Judy’S Room - Evening

entries.text: Please, Mulder, you've got to quit scaring me like that.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Oh, I'd like to quit.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: [[NDISTINCT CHATTERING OVER RADIO]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: So neighbors called police when they saw him acting Suspiciously.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: He was dumping firearms in the driveway.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: The doors were locked from the inside when they arrived?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Yeah, he wasn't responding.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: They broke through the window and broke in the door.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Has anybody offered up any evidence for how this could happen?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Well, it seems everyone's under the agreement that a man can't cut off his own head.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Oh, good to see there's still a shred of sanity left in this town.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: But I have to say, it's not outside the realm of extreme possibility.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Oh, so he tripped and fell and splattered the walls with blood?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Well, if he were a determined man...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: ..With a razor-sharp sword set on creating his own self-fulfilling prophecy--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: He was scared out of his mind, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Bedroom - Night

entries.text: Well, if he was tn his right mind, he might've called you. Oh, maybe he tried. Only he lost his head.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Dean Cavalier’S House - Living Room - Night

entries.text: [[NDISTINCT CHATTERING]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Dean Cavalier’S House - Living Room - Night

entries.text: You coming, Scully?
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Int. Dean Cavalier’S House - Living Room - Night

entries.text: [GASPS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Dean Cavalier’S House - Living Room - Night

entries.text: [SIGHS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Dean Cavalier’S House - Living Room - Night

entries.text: Oh, hey.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Dean Cavalier’S House - Living Room - Night

entries.text: Speak of the devil. I can't sleep, Mulder.
entries.speaker: Fox
entries.location: Int. Dean Cavalier’S House - Living Room - Night

entries.text: What's the problem? Something about this case is getting under my skin. Well, we've had stranger cases, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Anteroom - Night

entries.text: Can you hold me? Yeah. I can do that.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Anteroom - Night

entries.text: [DANA SIGHS]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Int. Small Town Motel - Suite Anteroom - Night
